description: This file is the root layout component for a Remix-run React web application. It manages global layout including head metadata, a layout wrapper component, navigation sidebar, top navigation, and main content outlet. It also exports loader functions for initial data fetching (environment variables and authentication state) and links for stylesheets. The file defines multiple React components and integrations with Remix APIs.

methods.name: links
methods.description: Provides link tags for external stylesheets, fonts for the application.

methods.name: loader
methods.description: Loader function that exposes environment variables and authentication status to the client.

methods.name: Layout
methods.description: Main layout component that wraps page content with HTML structure, head, and body.

methods.name: TopNav
methods.description: Component rendering the top navigation bar displaying app title, API URL, and login/logout button.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main application component rendering the top navigation, sidebar, and outlet for nested routes.
